# core:fuel

The deterministic cost of a region of a test.

[`measure`] runs a closure and, under `wado test --report-fuel`, reports
the fuel it spent: each Wasm instruction the guest ran, priced near the
time it takes (an `i32.add` costs 2). Fuel does not depend on the host, so
one run gives a figure that only a change to the program or to wasmtime
moves. The prices are approximate, and an allocation's share of collection
grows with the live set, which no price sees.

Without `--report-fuel` the closure just runs. Only `wado test` supports
it, and a program for any other world that reaches this module does not
compile.

## Synopsis

```wado
let n = builtin::black_box(1_000);
let sum = measure("sum", || {
    let mut s = 0;
    for let i of 0..<n {
        s += i;
    }
    return s;
});
assert sum == 499_500;
```

## Functions

### `pub fn measure<T, effect E>(label: String, mut f: fn mut() -> T with E) -> T with (E, FuelHost)`

Runs `f` and reports the fuel it spent as region `label` of the running
test. `f`'s result passes through `builtin::black_box`, so the work that
produces it is never optimized out of the region.

## Effects

### `pub interface FuelHost`

Host interface behind `core:fuel`. Only `wado test` supplies it, and only
under `--report-fuel` does it meter.

#### `fn spent() -> Option<u64>`

`#[cm("core:fuel/fuel-host@0.1.0#spent")]`

The fuel the running test has spent so far, or none when the run is
not metered.

#### `fn report(label: String, fuel: u64)`

`#[cm("core:fuel/fuel-host@0.1.0#report")]` `#[cm_params("label", "fuel")]`

Region `label` of the running test spent `fuel`.
